(89)bla sgrub ye shes drwa ba yi/rjes rim chogs kyi 'khor lo bzhugs/dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mchogadapal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad mor/dngos po ku

tei:div.tei:p: bla sgrub ye shes drwa ba yi/ rjes rim chogs kyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad mor/ dngos po kun gyis rab btud nas/ tshags kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bshad/ shin tu rnam dag ye shes ngor/ bla dang dor bas dben gyur yang*/ kun rdzob khyad du mi gsod phyir/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i/ gtsang zhing dag pa'i gza' btung dang*/ khyad par sngags kyi dam tshig rdzas/ sha dang chang du ldan par bshams/ rdo rje bdud rtsis bsang gtor bya/ 'di la don rnam par brgyad de/ dang po bsang sbyang byin gyis rlobs ni/ a/ rim pa'i byin rlabs 'byung ba che'i/ yi ge gsum gyi 'phro 'du las/ gzung 'jin rtog pa'i rkyen ngan kun/ bsreg gtor bkrus nas stong par sbyangs/ smra bsam brjod bral rig pa'i gshis/ dus gsum rtog pa sangs rgyas pa'i/ rjes snang snod bcud snang ba kun/ lhun grub dag pa mnyam brdal ba'i/ thabs shes nyi zla'i gzhong pa ru/ bza' bca' btung ba'i 'dod yon tshogs/ ma tshang med par spungs pa rnams/ 'bru gsum sngags kyis byin rlabs pas/ ngo bo zag med bdud rtsi la/ rnam pa dbang lnga'i longs spyod tshogs/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos kyis/ 'dod yon lha (90)mos nam mkha' gang*/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du gyur/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshogs zhing bsgrub pa ni/ spos btul rol mo sna tshogs bsgrags/ phem gyi sgra yis sad byas la/ rig pa hur bton gdug shugs bskyed/ a blo bral gdod ma'i rgyal khab che/ chos zad la zlos pho brang du/ kun khyab rig pa sangs rgyas pa'i/ chos sku'i bla ma gshegs su gsol/ rang mdangs lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ 'ja' zer thig le'i pho brang nas/ ye shes snying po sgyu ma'i lus/ longs sku'i bla ma gshegs su gsol/ nang gsal mkhyen cha ma 'gags pa/ zung 'jug thugs rjes kun khyab rtsal/ 'gro 'dul snying rje gar mjad rje/

sprul sku'i bla ma gshegs su gsol/ ri bo rtse lnga'i gzhal yas nas/ 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen rje/ rig 'jin 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ rig pa don gyi 'og min che/ sngon gshegs dur khrod gzhal yas nas/ rig 'jin (91)padma las 'brel rtsal/ mkha' 'gro'i 'khor bcas gshaigs su gsol/ bdag cag gdul bya'i snyigs ma rnams/ da dung sems kyi thag mo da/ rje btsun mi mngon dbyings su gshegs/ sems la sdug bsngal bzod blag med/ gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs shing*/ tshogs kyi zhing du spyan 'dren na/ glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rje yis/ da lta nyid du gshegs su gsol/ oṃ gu ru brgya dha ra ḍākki ni sa ma ya e e ra li pheṃ pheṃ jaḥ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ/ khu rdul sems gsum rnamadag la/ pad nyi zla ba'i gdan yangs par/ dag chen ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/ bsod nams zhing du bzhugs su saul/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ bzhi pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ ho/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i/ bca' bca' btung ba'i longs spyod rnams/ bde ba chen por lhun grub pa'i/ zhal zas tshogs phud mchod pa 'bul/ sarba gha ṇa tsakra pū ja khā hi/ lnga pa bar ba (92) bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ gzung 'jin rtog par kha brgyud pas/ nyams chags dri ma ci mchis pa/ gha ṇa tsakra'i mchod pas bshags/ ces dang yig brgya brjod/ drug pa bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ tshogs tha ma dmigs pa'i 'bem du bca' la/ ā/ rnam thar gsum gyi 'brub khung du/ log rtog rū tra btson du 'jin/ ye grol don dam phur bus gdab/ 'khor ba ka dag dbyings su bsgral/ rdo rje rnon po'i phyag rgya 'dis/ lnga phung zhen med dbyings su sbyang*/ phyir mi ldog par rgyas btab na/ slar skye ba dag ga la yod/ badzra ki la ya badzra tikṣa ru tra sha rlan mā ra ya rbad/ bdun pa zhal bstabs ni/

hūm̐/ dug gsum dbyings su bsgral ba yi/ sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas ni/ rdo rje bza' ba'i dam tshig rdzas/ a la la ste dgyes pa rol/ ha la pañtsa pu tsa ho/ skabs 'dir spro na rje nyid kyi gsung brgyud gsum rig 'jin bskang ba sbyar nalegs pa yin no/ de nas brda dang lag nyid kyis/ zhal zas pham rgyal med par drangs/ nang gi bsreg blugs tshul gyis rol/ gdan gsum grong khyer mnyes par bya/ mnyam nyid dgongs pa'i gdengs bskyed la/ (93) rdo rje gla gar rol rtsed rnas/ sgyu mig 'phrul ci bzhin spyod/ tsham bu gcig tu smon lam gdab/ brgyad pa lhag gtor btang ba ni/ a kā ro yi byin gyis brlabs/ ho/ da la chen po'i phyi rol du/ dpal gyi bka' sdod dam tshig can/ slas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las mjod/ ma ma uṣki ṭa ba ling ta khā hi/ de ni tshags kyi don brgyad do/ mjug chog nyid la'ang don bskyed do/ dang po thugs dam bskul ba no/ hūm̐/ mi gnas mi dmigs spros pa bral/ 'gro 'ong gnyis med pho brang nas/ rje btsun bla ma rin po che/ dus gsum rig 'jin rtsal 'chang rnams/ thugs dam bskul lo snyigs ma'i 'gro lnga bdo'i rgyud pas non pa dang*/ 'od gsal snying po'i bstan pa la/ dgongs nas zhi la mi gzhol bar/ rol pa chen po'i cho 'phrul gyis/ gsang chen rdo rje'i grub mtha' slongs/ 'gro kun gdod ma'i zad par sbyor/ 'khor ba stong pa'i phrin las mjod/ gnyis pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ 'bru gsum sngags kyi byin gyis rlabs/ hūm̐/ dus gsum dus med chen po'i dus/ 'khrul grol (94)ming med pho brang du/ rgyal sras padma las 'brel rtsal/ 'khrul pa gzhi la dag pa'i mthus/ spyi dpal chen por sangs rgyas tshe/ brgyud gsum dam can dregs pa'i tshogs/ tha tshig gsum gyis gnyer gtad bzhin/ dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ brgyud 'jin rig 'jin bdag cag gi

lhun grub snang bzhi mthar phyin nas/ rig pa sku ru smin pa dang*/ 'od lus grub pa'i sdong grogs mjod/ ces pas mchod gtor gtsang par phul/ gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ bhyo/ sangs rgyas padma thod phreng gis/ dbang bskur bod khams zhing skyong ba'i/ brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis/ gtor ma'i bzhes phrin las mjod/ bzhi pa rdo rje'i rta bro ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid chen po'i nga rgyal gyis/ rdo rje rta yi bro brdung pas/ gzung 'jin 'khrul pa rgyu dang bcas/ gnyis med klong du chems se chems/ st+wam bha ya nan/ slar yang gtang rag mchod cing bstod/ lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ nongs pa bshags pa gtor ma nyid/ bla ma'i gsang ba gsum du gsal/ mos gus gdung ba'i shugs bskyed la/ hūm̐/ thugs dam (95)chen po'i dus la babs/ sngon gyi g.yar dam mi bsnyel bar/ rdau rje sems dpa'i nam yang langs/ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus shes mjod/ rig pa rtsal gyi dbang mchog bskur/ rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur pa dang*/ dgongs pa'i rtsal chen yongs rjogs pa'i/ dngos grub dam pa rtsal du gsol/ bsnyen pa'i dzabda sngags dbyangs su len/ dgongs pa mi 'gyur gzer btab nas/ don gyi bla ma'i rang mdangs bskyang*/ tshe 'dir mthar thug grub mtha' snyogs/ drug pa bsdung srang rnal 'byor ni/ ā/ dag pa'i snod bcud snang cha kun/ blo bral dgongs pa'i gshis su yal/ slar yang snang grags dran rig kun/ bla ma'i gsang ba gsum du sad/ bdun pa bsngo ba smon lam ni/ ho/ bsod nams ye shes dge tshogs rgyun/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo/ mkha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus pa/ 'khor lo'i mgon po nyid gyur cig brgyud pa shis brjod mjug bsdu ni/ brgyud pa'i chu bo kun 'dus shing*/ byin rlabs dngos grub rgya mtsho'i (96)gter/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal rjes/ phral yun dge legs dpal stsol cig ces so de ltar zab mo bla sgrub kyi/

phrin las tshogs mchod nyung ngu 'di/ mos pa can gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ gang dran rtog pa ri mor spel/ dge ngos 'akor lo'i mgon po rje'i/ gsang ba gsum gyis byin rlabs kun/ dngos grub chen po'i pha phog tu/ thog nas don gnyis mthar phyin shog ces pa'ang 'gyur med rdo rjes sres so/// /
